messages:
maria (Docs): Heads-up: I'm splitting the big 'service-setup' refactor into 4 PRs so we don't break prod links. Will need a merge order and a short freeze window.
kevin (Platform): 👍 please list the PR numbers and which redirects file each touches.
sarah (Eng): FYI some of the SDK snippets reference the old paths (examples/python/service_setup.md). Those will 404 if we merge the renames first.
maria (Docs): PRs: #4891 (move and rename files), #4892 (update internal links), #4893 (redirects + netlify/_redirects update), #4894 (search index & toc changes).
maria (Docs): Proposed order: merge #4891 -> wait for docs preview to rebuild -> merge #4893 (redirects) -> #4892 -> #4894. We want redirects in place before link swaps.
kevin (Platform): Agree. Also: can we bundle the redirects update into a single atomically-applied file? Last time multiple small redirect PRs caused partial redirects to deploy and broke anchors.
maria (Docs): I consolidated all redirects into docs/_data/redirects.yaml in #4893. It contains path pairs + anchor mapping for the most fragile pages. Example: 
```
- from: /docs/old/service-setup
  to: /docs/service/setup
  anchors:
    - old-anchor-1:new-anchor-a
```
kevin (Platform): Nice. Make sure the Netlify and static-server schemas both read that file. I'll add a quick shim in platform infra.
jun (Docs-bot): Preview build started for PR #4891: https://docs-preview.internal/redwood/4891 — status: queued.
olivia (PM): Timing question: when do we want to merge? We have a customer migration next Tuesday; ideally redirects are live before then.
maria (Docs): Target: merge sequence tomorrow between 09:30–10:30 PT. I'll coordinate with infra to watch build logs.
sarah (Eng): A couple of anchor issues I found: the old /guides/auth#token-flow anchor becomes /guides/authentication#token-flow. Redirects.yaml needs an explicit mapping because our static router drops hashes otherwise.
maria (Docs): Added that mapping to #4893. Also added a short script to validate anchors: scripts/validate_anchors.py — run locally or in CI to catch broken anchors.
kevin (Platform): Can you add the script as a step in the docs CI? Quick check before merging. I can add a job that runs it on changed files only.
maria (Docs): Will do. PR #4891 contains the script and README snippet.
docs-ci-bot: CI passed on #4891 (build + lint). Preview URL: https://docs-preview.internal/redwood/4891 — note: missing anchors report attached.
maria (Docs): I saw the CI anchor report — one failure is in the SDK section: examples/node/auth.md links to /examples/old-api#usage. I'll submit a tiny follow-up patch to #4892 after #4893 is in.
sarah (Eng): Please add me as reviewer on #4891 and #4893 — I'll scan for reference regressions in SDK snippets.
maria (Docs): Added you. @kevin can you keep an eye on the netlify deploy timing? We should only merge #4892 after the redirect deploy is green.
kevin (Platform): I'll tag the deployment with 'docs-refactor-canary' and watch logs. If redirects fail, we can rollback the redirect file quickly.
jun (Docs-bot): Preview build completed for #4893: https://docs-preview.internal/redwood/4893 — status: success.
maria (Docs): Great — I'll merge #4891 now and wait for platform to confirm the preview site matches expected paths.
docs-ci-bot: Merge queued for #4891 — merge blocked until 2 approvals.
sarah (Eng): Approved.
olivia (PM): Approved (quick visual check).
docs-ci-bot: PR #4891 merged by maria. Live preview: https://docs-preview.internal/redwood/4891-live — building main site.
kevin (Platform): Redirects PR #4893 is next. I'll hold merging until I see the main-site build complete from #4891. If any anchor mapping is missing, we'll update #4893 before merging.
maria (Docs): Note to reviewers: please pay attention to any absolute links that reference the production domain (they need to be relative). I fixed most but a few slipped through (search for "https://docs.redwood.com/docs/").
sarah (Eng): Found one in examples/python/service_setup.md — added inline comment on #4892.
maria (Docs): After #4893 merges I'll run the search-index update (#4894) — that job depends on the final URL map.
docs-ci-bot: PR #4893 checks: redirects linting ok; anchor validator found 1 mapping missing for /guides/authentication#token-flow — see comment in PR.
maria (Docs): Pushed a tiny update to #4893 to add the missing mapping.
kevin (Platform): I see the new redirect file. Deploying now.
docs-ci-bot: Netlify deploy for redirects succeeded. Live site showing 301 redirects.
maria (Docs): Merging #4893.
docs-ci-bot: PR #4893 merged. Redirects live.
maria (Docs): OK cool. Now we can merge #4892 (link swaps). Please don't merge #4894 (search index) until after the scheduled nightly reindex.
sarah (Eng): Merged #4892 — small fix in a snippet.
maria (Docs): Thanks. I'll queue #4894 for tomorrow's nightly reindex window.
olivia (PM): Great job coordinating. One follow-up action: update the migration guide to mention the renamed paths and keep a short section on how to report broken anchors.
maria (Docs): Added a short section to /docs/migration/rename-notes.md in #4894.
kevin (Platform): Closing loop: I'll add a short monitor to alert if >0 404s on the renamed slug list for 24 hours.
maria (Docs): Thank you. If anyone sees odd client SDK link failures, ping here and we'll patch quick. :pray:
jun (Docs-bot): Thread summary: split refactor into 4 PRs, redirect file consolidated in #4893, anchor validator added, merge window scheduled and executed, redirects deployed, follow-up search reindex planned.
